_note: ayq-baidu-1 is a wing view of Uluru from the air (not the airport), and ayq-baidu-3 is an FSLabs P3Dv5 flight-simulator screenshot.

ayq-baidu-2.webp.zh: 航站楼前的接驳区：通往乌鲁鲁的观光大巴停在带顶棚的走廊旁，站牌写着机场与团队集合点。
ayq-baidu-2.webp.en: The transfer area outside the terminal — Uluru tour coaches lined up under the covered walkway beside the airport meeting-point signs.

ayq-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 暮色中，一排白色帐篷式尖顶被落日镀金，一架白色支线客机停在旁边，旅客提着行李走向机坪边缘。
ayq-chatgpt-01.webp.en: At dusk the terminal's row of white tent peaks glows in the low sun while a white regional jet waits nearby and passengers walk out to the apron.

ayq-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 红土机坪上停着数架客机，其中一架标有Jetstar，巨大的赭色岩体在远处地平线露出一线轮廓。
ayq-chatgpt-02.webp.en: On the red-earth apron several airliners are parked, one of them marked Jetstar, with the vast ochre rock just showing on the distant horizon.

ayq-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 跑道一端，一架尾翼绘着袋鼠标志的客机停在13号跑道数字旁，赭红色巨岩横卧在低矮灌木平原的尽头。
ayq-chatgpt-03.webp.en: At one end of the runway a jet with a kangaroo on its tail waits by the painted 13 marker, the great ochre rock lying beyond low scrub.

ayq-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 砖红色航站楼的廊檐上用金属字母拼出康奈兰机场的英文名，玻璃门前有旅客进出，前方是空旷的停车场。
ayq-chatgpt-04.webp.en: Metal letters above the brick-red terminal spell out Connellan Airport, travellers passing through the glass doors in front of an empty car park.

ayq-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 烈日下，一架白色客机停在机坪上，旅客正沿舷梯登机，地面刷着设备通道的红色大字，远处是红色荒原。
ayq-chatgpt-05.webp.en: Under a hard blue sky a Virgin Australia jet waits with stairs at its door as passengers walk across the apron, red desert along the horizon.

ayq-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 航站楼内，成排金属座椅沿墙摆开，红色自助值机柜台前排着隔离带，地面反着光，远处墙面刷成青绿色。
ayq-chatgpt-06.webp.en: Inside the terminal, rows of metal seats line the wall while red self-service kiosks and queuing posts fill the hall, a teal wall at the far end.

ayq-chatgpt-07.webp.zh: 隔着舷窗俯瞰，一条长跑道斜切过红色荒原，机坪上停着一架客机，航站楼与停车场挤在跑道一侧。
ayq-chatgpt-07.webp.en: Seen through a cabin window, a long runway slants across red desert while an airliner sits on the apron and the terminal and car park crowd one side.
